statements: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.EDI_PSI_HDR', N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.EDI_PSI_HDR  (ODBC_ID VARCHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY, TRANSACTION_SET VARCHAR(5), CUST_ID VARCHAR(15), ST_ID VARCHAR(15), PO_NUM VARCHAR(22), V_STATUS VARCHAR(20), V_STATUS_DT DATETIME)
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CUSTOMER', N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.CUSTOMER  (ID VARCHAR(15) PRIMARY KEY, SALESREP_ID VARCHAR(15), TERRITORY VARCHAR(15))

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CUST_ADDRESS', N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.CUST_ADDRESS  (CUSTOMER_ID VARCHAR(15), ADDR_NO INT, NAME VARCHAR(50), ADDR_1 VARCHAR(50), ADDR_2 VARCHAR(50), ADDR_3 VARCHAR(50), CITY VARCHAR(50), STATE VARCHAR(50), ZIPCODE VARCHAR(10), COUNTRY VARCHAR(50), SHIPTO_ID VARCHAR(15), PRIMARY KEY (CUSTOMER_ID, ADDR_NO))
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CUSTOMER_ORDER', N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.CUSTOMER_ORDER  (ID VARCHAR(15) PRIMARY KEY, CUSTOMER_PO_REF VARCHAR(22), SHIPTO_ID VARCHAR(15))

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CUSTOMER_ORDER_LINE', N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.CUSTOMER_ORDER_LINE  (CUST_ORDER_ID VARCHAR(15), PART_ID VARCHAR(30), PROMISE_DEL_DATE DATETIME, TOTAL_SHIPPED_QTY DECIMAL(14,4), PRIMARY KEY (CUST_ORDER_ID, PART_ID))

INSERT INTO EDI_PSI_HDR (ODBC_ID, TRANSACTION_SET, CUST_ID, ST_ID, PO_NUM, V_STATUS, V_STATUS_DT) SELECT RIGHT('0000' + CAST(n AS VARCHAR), 10), '830', 'C01558', 'ST001', 'PO' + CAST(n AS VARCHAR), 'READY', GETDATE() FROM (SELECT TOP 1000 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM master.dbo.spt_values) AS numbers
INSERT INTO CUSTOMER (ID, SALESREP_ID, TERRITORY) SELECT 'C01558', 'SR001', 'TERR001'

INSERT INTO CUST_ADDRESS (CUSTOMER_ID, ADDR_NO, NAME, ADDR_1, ADDR_2, ADDR_3, CITY, STATE, ZIPCODE, COUNTRY, SHIPTO_ID) SELECT 'C01558', 1, 'Customer Name', 'Addr1', 'Addr2', 'Addr3', 'City', 'State', '12345', 'Country', 'ST001'
INSERT INTO CUSTOMER_ORDER (ID, CUSTOMER_PO_REF, SHIPTO_ID) SELECT 'ORD001', 'PO1', 'ST001'
INSERT INTO CUSTOMER_ORDER_LINE (CUST_ORDER_ID, PART_ID, PROMISE_DEL_DATE, TOTAL_SHIPPED_QTY) SELECT 'ORD001', 'PART001', GETDATE() + 15, 0
